excerpt: Engineering teams adopting the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) often struggle to turn concepts into working code. This post walks through two reference implementations on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Kiro, and Claude Code: an SQL-to-ER-diagram generator and a multi-agent code security analyzer that put the AI-DLC construction phase into practice.
